seed_programs.name: Sovereign Tech Fund
seed_programs.application_state_basis: The official Fund page says applications are accepted exclusively through the online application platform and does not publish a closing date.
seed_programs.program_eligibility_text: Official text requires open digital base technologies; OSI-approved or FSF Free/Libre licenses for code; Creative-Commons-like documentation licenses without non-commercial or no-derivatives clauses; German or English submissions; worldwide applicants; no other public financing for the same proposed activities; and that the Fund is not currently looking for user-facing applications such as messaging apps or file storage and does not finance the development of prototypes.
seed_programs.funding_text: The cost of the work described in the application must exceed EUR 50,000 (current minimum). No fixed upper limit is stated on the inspected Fund page.
seed_programs.matching_basis: Matching was not independently established from the inspected Fund page.
seed_programs.ip_terms: Supported code and documentation must be freely reusable, changeable, and redistributable under OSI-approved or FSF Free/Libre licenses for code.
deliverables: Work related to developing or maintaining open digital base technologies as described by the Fund page.
Portal application through apply.sovereign.tech. This registry does not create an account or submit.
seed_programs.fit_note: ANALYSIS: Public RINGDELTA organ bytes and TITAN Hands substrate receipts may relate to base-technology language, but the prototype exclusion, user-facing-application exclusion, missing root LICENSE file, and unknown applicant entity remain unresolved. This is not an eligibility finding.
seed_programs.public_next_action: Compare already-public RINGDELTA and TITAN Hands receipts with the Fund base-technology and prototype exclusions. Do not register or submit.
private_blockers: Root LICENSE still absent on this main
Whether the work is a prototype versus maintained base technology

seed_programs.ip_terms: Project results shall always become available under a recognised free or open source license. Detailed MoU terms remain UNKNOWN.
deliverables: Auxiliary free and open source work contributing to CodeSupply software-metadata, access, or framework objectives.

seed_programs.program_eligibility_text: Many libre funders require an OSI or FSF license. This repository snapshot does not publish a root license file.
seed_programs.funding_text: UNKNOWN: this is a blocker row, not a funder.
seed_programs.ip_terms: UNKNOWN: no root LICENSE file on current main. Do not invent CC0, MIT, Apache, or GPL terms.
deliverables: Owner-directed public license decision if one is to exist.
Until then, NLnet and Sovereign Tech Fund IP terms cannot be matched from this repository.
seed_programs.fit_note: ANALYSIS: Missing root LICENSE is a public blocker for libre-license funders. Publishing a license would be an owner legal act, not a peer invention.
